text: Overcurrent and feeder protection – SIPROTEC 7SJ85 | Siemens

The SIPROTEC 7SJ85 is an overcurrent protection device designed for feeders, lines and capacitor banks. Its modular structure and powerful DIGSI 5 engineering tool offer flexible, future-oriented solutions for protection, control and automation. Conformal coating of the electronic boards ensures the highest availability and safety, even under extreme environmental conditions. With its modular structure, flexibility and the powerful DIGSI 5 engineering tool, the SIPROTEC 7SJ85 device offers future-oriented solutions for protection, control, automation, monitoring and PQ basic.
heading: Why SIPROTEC 7SJ85?

text: Conformal coating provides an extra level of protection for SIPROTEC relay and control devices used in extremely harsh environments and extends the lifetime of your devices.
heading: Highest availability

text: The SIPROTEC 7SJ85 provides directional and non-directional overcurrent protection with additional functions, as well as protection of up to 9 feeders with up to 40 analog inputs.
heading: Overcurrent protection
